test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money becomes Rs. 12,600 after 6 years and Rs. 21,000 after 9 years on compound interest. The sum invested is:
solution:
**Given:-**

A₁ = Rs.12600

T₁ = 6 years

A₂ = Rs. 21000

T₂ = 9 years

**Formula used:-**

Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

where, r = rate of interest

**Calculation:-**

According to question,

⇒ 12600 = P(1 + r/100)⁶ ......(i)

⇒ 21000 = P(1 + r/100)⁹ .......(ii)

From eqn (ii) / eqn (i)

⇒ 21000/12600 = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ (5/3)⁽¹/³⁾ = (100 + r)/100 .......(iii)

Now from eqn (i)

⇒ 12600 = P(1 + r/100)6

and from eqn (iii)

⇒ 12600 = P[(5/3)¹/³]⁶

⇒ 12600 = P(5/3)²

Principal (P) = 12600 × 9/25

P = Rs. 4536

∴** Principal is Rs. 4536**
